about.copy: I'm a Software Development student at the University of Utah who likes understanding how software behaves beyond the happy path. My projects have taken me from fuzzing emulator subsystems and training computer-vision models to building desktop tools and physical prototypes. I tend to learn by getting something working, testing where the assumptions break, and using what I observe to decide what to improve next.
about.engineeringApproach: I usually start by understanding the constraints, prototype the risky part early, and use code, tests, and observed behavior to decide what to change next.
